newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet lower with futures, premiums still high.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet lower with futures, premiums still high.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices ended slightly lower on Monday in line with futures, although premiums remained firm, traders said.
On the cif cargo market premiums were put at roughly Sept IPE +$35/+$37, but traders said the market was pretty inactive.
"Quite frankly at these prices who will come in," one trader said.

There was talk some U.S. Gulf jet fuel cargoes could be bound for NWE, but a number of traders said U.S. jet fuel was more likely to head for the Mediterranean where prices are even higher and availability tighter.
